Landa isignesha yakamuva ye-Pixel Canary ku-Google

Isignesha ye-Canary ihlolwa okungenani kanye ngosuku, futhi ishintshwa ngokuzenzakalela uma isale cishe amasonto amabili ukuba iphelelwe yisikhathi. Ukulungiswa kwe-Canary kuphelelwa yisikhathi cishe emasontweni ayisithupha kusukela osukwini lokukhishwa kwayo — ukuphelelwa yisikhathi kuboniswa ohlelweni lokulungiswa okusebenzayo.

Ukusetha ngesandla:
1. Thepha "Thola isignesha ye-Pixel Canary" bese ukhetha idivayisi.
2. Uma kungatholakali amadivayisi, ngenisa ifayela lokulungiswa le-PIF elisebenzayo emthonjeni othembekile. Amafayela wokulungiswa awanikezwa.
3. Hlola futhi isimo sakho se-Play Integrity.

Hlala ususa ukulungiswa okusebenzayo ngaphambi kokungenisa okusha. Ukulayisha ifayela le-PIF eliphelelwe yisikhathi kuzohlulekisa ukuqiniseka okuqinile kwe-TrickyStore, ngisho nakuba i-keybox isebenza.

Ukufaka amanga okuthuthukisiwe:
• Ukufaka amanga kwesignesha ye-Play Store — hlala ucimile ngaphandle uma kuncoma okunye. Ukufaka amanga kwe-FINGERPRINT ku-Play Store akudingeki kaningi futhi kungabangela izinkinga.
• Faka amanga ku-SDK ku-Play Store — ibonisa i-SDK 32 ku-Play Store ukuze iphoqelele indlela yakudala yokwahlulela ngaphambi kwe-Android 13. Ingaphazamisa ukusebenza kwe-Play Store, ngakho-ke yishiye icimile ngaphandle kokuhlola.
• Faka amanga kumasimu wokwakha kanye nezakhiwo zesistimu — yishiyeivuliwe. Zibonisa isignesha ku-DroidGuard.
• Faka amanga kumhlinzeki we-keystore — yishiye icimile uma i-keybox isetshenziswa, njengoba ikhipha ukuqinisekiswa kwe-keybox.
• Faka amanga kusayina we-ROM — okulingiwe.
Setha zonke izinketho zokufaka amanga okuthuthukisiwe zibe ngokuzenzakalelayo? Isignesha yamanje izogcinwa.
Buyisela inani lokuzenzakalela lawo wonke amaswishi angenhla. Isignesha izogcinwa
Bonisa izakhiwo zesignesha (imodeli, idivayisi, isignesha, …) ku-DroidGuard
Bonisa i-ID yokwakha, isibuyekezo sokuphephela, izinga le-API kanye nesazisi somkhiqizo ku-DroidGuard
Yenza isixhumanisi sesitifiketi se-DroidGuard sihluleke. Lokhu kudlula ukuqinisekiswa kwe-keybox, ngakho-ke yishiye icimile uma i-keybox isetshenziswa
Okulingiwe. Hlanganisa umkhawulo we-ROM wokhiye bokuhlola kwe-DroidGuard
Ilawula ukuthi isignesha ethile yethulwa kuqoqo le-Play Store

Bonisa i-SDK 32 ku-Play Store ukuze iphoqelele indlela yakudala ka-<A13. Ayikaze iphakanyiswe ngaphezu kwe-SDK yangempela. Ingaphazamisa ukusebenza kwe-Play Store, ngakho-ke yishiye icimile ngaphandle uma kuhlolwa
Ukusebenzisa le signesha kusebenza kangcono ngesikhathi esisha se-Play Store. Susa idatha yohlelo ye-Play Store manje? Lokhu kuzokuphuma ngemvume futhi kusule i-cache yasendaweni nomugqa wokulanda.
Phatha ukulungiswa kwe-PIF kanye nezisignesha zedivayisi ukuze uthole ukuqiniseka okuyisisekelo

Lokhu kusula ukulungiswa kwe-Play Integrity, ukushintsha kwesignesha yokuphephela kanye nokulungiswa kwe-GameProps, kubuyisele uhlu lwezinhloso ze-TrickyStore olujwayelekile. I-keybox yakho iyagcinwa. I-Play Integrity nezinga lokuphephela kuzothathwa futhi kungakapheli isikhathi esifushane. Izinguquko zokunika amandla azishintshiwe.
Buyisela i-Play Integrity, uhlu lwezinhloso, izinga lokuphephela kanye ne-GameProps ezilungiselelweni zokuzenzakalela. I-keybox yakho iyagcinwa
Faka amanga kuSnapchat njenge-Pixel XL ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga zengxoxo ezingase zibe khona
Nika izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethiwe ukufinyelela ezici ze-AI ezingeni le-Pixel Tensor
Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethiwe zizobika izici zehadiwe ye-Tensor ukuze zivule i-AI nokusebenza okuvele kuPixel
Phatha i-keybox kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezinhloso ukuze uthole ukuqinisekiswa okuqinile
Ukuqinisekiswa kwesitifiketi se-keybox akulungile noma akukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Kungenzeka ukuthi yonakele noma yaphazanyiswa. Ingabe ufuna ukuyishintsha ngekeybox esemthethweni?

Isitifiketi se-keybox esi siphelelwa yisikhathi ngo-%1$s. Okwamanje sidlula ukuqinisekiswa kodwa siyeka ukusebenza ngemva kokuphela kwesikhathi. Ingabe ufuna ukuyishintsha manje ngekeybox esemthethweni?
I-keybox yakho isebenza — akudingeki ukuthola okusha
Ayikho i-keybox evumelekile okwamanje, izozama futhi kusasa

I-keybox iyalandwa futhi igcinwe isebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo. Isimo sokuhoxiswa sihlolwa njalo emahoreni angu-24, futhi i-keybox entsha ilandwa emthonjeni osemthethweni uma eyamanje ihoxisiwe noma imisiwe.

Ukusetha ngesandla:
1. Thepha u-"Landa i-keybox esemthethweni" ukuze ulande eyodwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, noma ungenise eyakho kumthombo othembekile.
2. Vula "Phatha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlosiwe" bese ukhetha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezidinga ukuhlolwa kobuqotho.
3. Setha imodi yehedu ku-"Leaf" uma idivayisi yakho inye-TEE esebenzayo; ngaphandle kwalokho shiya ku-Auto.
4. Hlola futhi isimo sakho se-Play Integrity.

Qaphela: Uma ingekho i-keybox esemthethweni evumelekile, ukulanda ngokuzenzakalelayo kumiswa amahora angu-24 ngaphambi kokuzama futhi. Hlala usula i-keybox ekhona ngaphambi kokungenisa elisha.
Ichweqe lesitifiketi alivumelekile — thepha ukuze uyishintshe
I-keybox izophelelwa yisikhathi maduze — thepha ukuze ubuyekeze
Ichweqe le-keybox linempande engaziwa — lisenza ladlula ubuqotho
Ayikho izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihambisana nokusesha noma nokusethwa kwakho
Le keybox inochweqe lesitifiketi elinemvelaphi kumnyango ongawaziwa yi-Resurrected Remix. Lisenza lidlule i-Strong Integrity kwamanye amadivayisi. Yigcine ifakiwe noma uyishintshe ngeyesemthethweni?
Faka amanga ezakhiwo zedivayisi zezinhlelo zokusebenza nemidlalo ethile
